name: bailian-train-deploy
description: Use the Bailian CLI (`bl`) to run the full closed loop of "data → fine-tuning → export → deployment → invocation", or skip training and deploy a base model directly. Supports fine-tuning text models (SFT/DPO/CPT), audio TTS models (CosyVoice), image generation models (Wan2.7), and video generation models (Wan i2v/kf2v). Covers dataset validation/upload, creating fine-tuning jobs, waiting for training, exporting the best checkpoint, creating inference deployments, waiting until ready, and providing call examples. Activate this skill whenever the user mentions "train a model" / 训练模型, "fine-tune" / "fine-tune" / "finetune" / 微调, "deploy a model" / 部署模型, "put the model online" / 模型上线, "run/call my fine-tuned model" / 把微调模型跑起来, "train a reasoning model" / 训练一个推理模型, "continued pretraining" / 继续预训练, "LoRA/SFT/DPO training" / LoRA/SFT/DPO 训练, "speech synthesis model" / 语音合成模型, "TTS fine-tuning" / TTS 微调, "CosyVoice", "voice cloning" / 声音克隆, "image generation fine-tuning" / 图像生成微调, "text-to-image" / 文生图, "image-to-image" / 图生图, "Wan2.7", "image model training" / 图像模型训练, "video generation fine-tuning" / 视频生成微调, "image-to-video" / 图生视频, "first-frame-to-video" / 首帧生视频, "first-and-last-frame" / 首尾帧, "kf2v", "i2v", "Wan video" / Wan视频, or "video effect training" / 视频特效训练 on Bailian / DashScope / Alibaba Cloud Model Studio. Even if the user does not explicitly say "use bl", as long as the intent is training or deployment on the Bailian platform, use this skill instead of assembling commands yourself.

findings.excerpt: bl finetune checkpoints --job-id <JOB_ID>          # list available checkpoints
bl speech synthesize --model <DEPLOYED_MODEL> --voice default --text "The text to synthesize" --out result.mp3
